mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month compresses equity discount rates and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals restrictive monetary policy with weak labor conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0 AND UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700000), housing market strength and consumer spending signals overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500 AND RSAFS > 700000, or Rank IC for regime signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) over the prior month indicates improving economic conditions and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) over the prior quarter indicates broad economic contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND GDPC1 < 24000, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced consumer spending and corporate profit pressures cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
